# board-store

The board as the harness serves it: the documents kept under the state directory, the atomic commits with their idempotency keys, the client state navigation writes without a revision, and the bus methods the tools and clients call.

- **Runs in:** the harness process
- **Source:** [lisp/modules/harness-board-store.el](../../lisp/modules/harness-board-store.el)
- **Loaded:** when enabled (see `harness-enable-modules`)
- **Requires:** [board](board.md), [board-edit](board-edit.md), [store](store.md), [linking](linking.md)
- **Required by:** [board-svg](board-svg.md), [tools-board](tools-board.md)

## About

The board as the harness serves it (harness-board.el, the grammar and
the document; harness-board-edit.el, the operations and patches): the
boards kept under the state directory, the commits that write them, the
undo history that survives a restart, and the bus methods a client and a
tool call.

THE STORE.  One JSON document per board, `boards/BOARD.json` under
`harness-state-directory`, written atomically.  A board's client state --
where each client's viewport and selection are, and the last place a
client was asked to look -- is `boards/BOARD.views.json`, a second
document that navigation writes without making a revision: two people
scrolling a board is not an edit of it.

A COMMIT is serialized.  The harness runs on one Emacs thread, so a
commit checks its read set and writes the document in one turn of the
loop: either the whole batch lands or none of it does.  A commit whose
idempotency key was used before answers what it answered then, so a
retried call after a lost answer commits once.  The keys are kept with
the board, bounded, so a restart does not re-commit a retry either.

THE METHODS.  `board/list`, `board/get`, `board/create`, `board/delete`,
`board/patch`, `board/preview`, `board/commit`, `board/undo`,
`board/grammar`, `board/link/describe`, `board/focus` and `board/views`.
Each is callable over ACP as `_harness/board/...`, so the Flutter client
and the Emacs page read and write the same boards through the same calls
the agent's tools use.  `board/changed` announces every commit.

## Provides

### Methods

- `board/commit` (id patch-id hash expected &optional opts) — Apply a validated patch to board ID atomically.
- `board/create` (id name &optional opts) — Make a board named NAME with id ID, in the project OPTS names.
- `board/delete` (id) — Delete board ID and its client state.
- `board/discuss` (id object &optional opts) — Start or answer a discussion on OBJECT of board ID, in its task's review.
- `board/discussions` (id &optional opts) — Return the discussions of board ID: its objects' threads, newest first.
- `board/focus` (id &optional opts) — Ask a connected client to show a place on board ID.
- `board/get` (id &optional opts) — Return board ID as a client draws it, for the diagram OPTS names.
- `board/grammar` — Return the board grammar: shapes, operations, styles, units and limits.
- `board/link/describe` (resource) — Return RESOURCE, a typed link of an object or relationship, resolved.
- `board/list` (&optional opts) — Return the boards in the store, newest first.
- `board/patch` (id ops &optional opts) — Return the patch applying OPS to board ID: validated, not committed.
- `board/pin` (id &optional opts) — Pin board ID's revision as a delivered artifact, and return the pin.
- `board/pins` (id &optional opts) — Return the pins of board ID, newest first.
- `board/preview` (id ops &optional opts) — Render the exact batch OPS for board ID without changing anything.
- `board/undo` (id &optional opts) — Take back the newest commit of board ID, or the one OPTS names.
- `board/views` (id &optional opts) — Return the client state of board ID: viewports, selections and the last focus.

### Events

- `board/changed` — (:board ID :revision N :patch ID :created (ID ...) :changed (ID ...)) after a board commit.
- `board/created` — (:board ID) after a board is made.
- `board/deleted` — (:board ID) after a board is removed.
- `board/focused` — (:board ID :diagram ID :object ID :revision N) when a client is asked to a place.
- `board/pinned` — (:board ID :pin ID :revision N :diagram ID) after a board revision is pinned.

### Options

- `harness-board-writers` — Sessions allowed to edit every board, or nil for any session.
